'''Bashenn''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rutian/Legends|Rutian]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] and security chief who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Bashenn was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartels]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Bashenn appointed to the position of guard captain after the healer [[Vederiat Ayon]] relieved [[Odumis Mer]] of his position on account of his mental instability. He was not friendly to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as he resented them for abandoning the pilgrims to fend for themselves against the [[Flesh Raider]]s.<ref name="TOR" />

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], Bashenn was preparing Kalikori village for the [[Festival of Awakening]] when he was approached by a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[The Barsen'thor|Padawan]] who asked about the whereabouts of [[Nalen Raloch]], the establishment's champion guardian. Bashenn was very resistant to the idea of helping a Jedi, and was already busy enough with the festivities, but the Padawan convinced him that it was in his best interest to divulge Raloch's location. Bashenn gave in and told the Padawan of a [[Nalen Raloch's cave camp|camp]] that Raloch kept within Flesh Raider territory where he assumed their protector might be.
